**Company Description**
**About QAD Redzone**
 Redzone helps manufacturers make more stuff for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4\.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected worker.” We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 22% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.
   

  

 With over 1000 customers, 1200 plants and 325,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 with a bold vision to transform manufacturing performance, while bringing dignity back to the frontline worker. Redzone provides the tools that enable the self\-organizing adaptive behavior of the front\-line manufacturing team to win the productivity game, avoiding downtime, or quality losses.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Under the leadership of Coaching Director, the Project Manager is responsible for management and oversight of Redzone’s project implementation.
   

  

 This position is Full Time, Remote and required to travel 40% of the time.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate and lead the customer journey for 6\-12 weeks after each new customer is added until we go onsite to coach.
* Participate in onsite Success Plan to focus the customer on the priority activities that need completion.
* Ensure signals are connected and tested prior to onsite coaching.
* Support the infrastructure and installation for Visual Factory.
* Guide the customer and provide support configuration to map Redzone to the customer’s site.
* Highlight any risks and address them with the customer team, Coaching Director, and Platform Leadership.
* Responsible for overseeing the deployment of Redzone software for multiple concurrent clients\- manage the process from the handover from the sales team through providing onsite coaching services.
* Configure and setup Redzone software that matches the production process at the client’s manufacturing plant. This process must include manufacturing data such as product and equipment information and product run rates.
* Ensure automation signals from the plant (such as photo eyes or machine cycles) come back to the software and provide accurate and real time data to Redzone for the shop floor team.
* Ensure the contractor work with the hardware and automation happens quickly and efficiently while maintaining the project schedule and cost plan.
* Perform regular weekly status calls with active project teams across multiple clients in order to ensure project stays on track and all milestones are achieved.
* Responsible for the success of the software and coaching a “Green Go Live” based on project management leading up to that point.
* Manage client relationships and satisfaction, including but not limited to serving as the point of contact for projects, responding to client requests, and critical events in a professional and timely manner.
* Understand the escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could result in delays or unsatisfactory project result(s).
* Document and maintain the project templates, training decks, and communication tools that are used with clients.
* Support on\-site Continuous Improvement Coaches and customers with configuration, expansion, and automation requests.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**
* Understand the shop floor environment, workflow, and processes in Food \& Beverage and Consumer Packaged Goods’ for a variety of industries with the necessary depth to foster confidence and to support the client during the project.
* Sound judgement and excellent assessment skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Understand escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could cause a delay or unsatisfactory project result.
* Experience working with project management, ideally in software or systems deployments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing or supporting software projects of different sizes, complexity and contractual types.
* Proven ability to cut through barriers to accomplish tasks.
* Confident with MS Office Suite, Windows operating systems and Apple hardware/operating systems.
* Ability to plan, organize, and function effectively in a dynamic environment, addressing multiple demands of internal teams and clients. Manage multiple deadlines and tasks.
* Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with clients as well as internal teams.
* Ability to self\-manage and prioritize tasks across active projects to meet critical path deadlines.
* Able to work in a high paced, high growth environment.
* Tech friendly \& comfortable communicating technical requirements regarding networking, wireless, and software information.
* Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) experience and familiarity is a plus, but not required


**Education/Experience**
* BA or BS – Relevant fields of study can include and are not limited to: Engineering, Manufacturing, Organizational Leadership/Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Management.
* 4\+ years in a similar position\-providing direct coaching to business clients.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or Hierarchy.

**About QAD And QAD Redzone**
 QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises.
   

  

 QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD’s vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.

**About PRAGATI** 




 Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low\-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher\-income economic activity.
 



 PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF\-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:
 


* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non\-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.



 PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands\-on implementation. It identifies high\-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.
 



 PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10\-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro\-processing, labour\-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 PRAGATI is working with the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) to help shape the next phase of rural development — building on MoRD's strong welfare and infrastructure delivery platform to increasingly enable sustained income growth and rural prosperity. The engagement focuses on three pathways: increasing agricultural incomes, creating non\-farm local livelihood opportunities, and enabling skilling for remunerative migration.
 



 The Senior Program Manager – Rural Economic Transformation (MoRD) will lead this engagement on a day\-to\-day basis. The role combines strategy, policy and execution — identifying and structuring complex problems, conducting rigorous analysis, designing practical interventions, building alignment with government and ecosystem stakeholders, and driving initiatives through implementation. The SPM will lead a small team and work closely with senior MoRD officials, PRAGATI leadership, financial institutions, experts and private\-sector partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with MoRD and PRAGATI leadership to identify and prioritise high\-impact opportunities for increasing rural incomes.
* Structure complex problems into clear hypotheses, analytical workstreams and actionable interventions.
* Lead research and analysis across agriculture, rural enterprise, finance, skilling and migration.
* Translate priority opportunities into practical program and policy designs, including implementation models, financing mechanisms and outcome frameworks.
* Build the economic and operational case for new initiatives and government partnerships, working with experts and ecosystem partners to refine solutions.
* Translate ministry priorities into clear workplans, owners, milestones and deliverables, and establish a strong operating rhythm across workstreams.

**About Sol’s Arc**
 Sol’s ARC is a registered NGO working to ensure that every child learns and every adult earns through inclusive education and vocational skilling. For over 20 years, we have partnered with governments, donors, and communities to create systemic change and equity for persons with disabilities.
   

  

 Our work spans inclusive education, vocational skilling, and systemic advocacy with government bodies at state and national levels — with a reach of over 4 million beneficiaries. This role sits within our Programs function, driving data\-informed decision\-making that strengthens the impact and credibility of our work.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We are looking for an experienced Program Manager with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in program documentation, data collection, and monitoring \& evaluation. Experience or understanding working on developing web\-based or app\-based program management monitoring systems is desirable. This role is central to how Sol’s ARC tracks, measures, and communicates its impact — managing documentation systems, designing data frameworks, and translating data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You will work closely with Program, M\&E, and Technology teams to ensure accurate, timely reporting aligned with organisational and donor requirements.
   

  

**Approximately**
**HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME**
**30% – M and E Systems, Documentation \& Reporting**
**30% – Data Analysis, Quality Checks \& Program Monitoring**
**20% – Data Collection and Management**
**20% – Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Capacity Building**
**What You’ll Actually Do**
**M and E systems, Documentation \& Reporting**
* Ensure all data collection systems and tools are aligned with program goals and reporting frameworks.
* Design M \& E forms and tools
* Develop dashboards, MIS reports and presentation for internal and external stakeholders
* Collaborate with technology teams to develop or integrate tools that support streamlined data collection, tool design and data management.
* Prepare program and donor reports with well\-documented data, analysis, and evidence of impact
* Prepare regular program briefs based on surveys and assessments that support programmatic development and strategic decision\-making.
* Provide support in development of proposals
* Develop logframes, define indicators
* Track all program activities, milestones, and impact data


**Data Analysis, Quality Checks \& Program Monitoring**
* Analyse program data both quantitative and qualitative to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for program enhancement.
* Conduct data quality checks and validation
* Monitor program indicators and its progress
* Identify trends, gaps and areas requiring improvement or corrective action.
* Conduct field visits as and when required


**Data Management**
* Maintain detailed, organised records in a central repository that facilitate easy retrieval of information for team use and donor communications.
* Design and implement effective data collection protocols and processes for various programs, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and consistency.
* Ensure all data collection, storage and management follow data privacy and protection protocols.
* Coordinate with field/program teams on data requirements, data collection challenges, and gaps
* Ensure data collection is complete, consistent and usable for analysis


**Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Capacity Building**
* Conducting cross\-team discussions to understand program implementation and data collection challenges
* Provide M and E data and platform related technical support.
* building program teams capacity to collect, manage, and use data effectively
* Participate in team meetings, sharing insights, providing recommendations, and keeping staff informed on documentation and data management practices.
* Represent Sol’s ARC in donor reviews and external evaluations as required.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Program documentation is current, complete, and audit\-ready at all times.
* Data collection systems are consistently used by field teams with high accuracy and minimal errors.
* Donor reports are submitted on time with clear evidence of impact and no discrepancies flagged.
* Leadership has timely, reliable data to make informed decisions about program strategy and resource allocation.
* A culture of data\-driven reflection is embedded within program teams.


**What’s Hard About This Role**
* Building data collection habits in field teams with varying levels of digital literacy and capacity.
* Translating complex data into simple, compelling narratives for diverse audiences — from community workers to government partners to international donors.
* Travelling across rural and urban locations in India to support field teams and ensure data quality at source.
* Keeping pace with evolving M\&E frameworks, donor reporting standards, and technology tools in a fast\-growing organisation.

* You will build deep expertise in program M\&E, data management, and development sector reporting.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Technical Project Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Head Office) \| Work from the office
 



  





**Experience:** 
 5 to 8 years
 



  





**Gynoveda** 
 is India's first Ayurveda fertility healthcare company. 50\+ clinics across India. 100\+ doctors—20,000\+ babies born through our treatment. We treat period health, PCOS, and infertility at the root cause, and we are expanding.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 The architecture is decided. The agency builds. You make sure what they build is right.
 



  





 You convert the blueprint into agency deliverables. You review the code and design that comes back. You catch what is wrong before it goes live. You run delivery sprint by sprint. You manage a team of two, a DevOps Engineer and a Website Specialist, and you work directly with the founders.
 



  





 This role needs range, not one deep specialty. ERP, integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, websites. You have worked hands\-on across most of these earlier in your career. Now you can review and question all of them without building any—one person, holding the entire stack accountable.
 



  





 We run on off\-the\-shelf tools, configured well. Custom development is the exception. If your first instinct is to build from scratch, this role is not for you. If your first instinct is to check whether the vendor configured the existing tool correctly, apply.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  




* Technical review of all agency deliverables: code, architecture, quality gates
* The integration layer connecting our systems: specification, build oversight, testing, go\-live
* Website platform evaluation, migration, and optimization
* Marketing technology integrations, validated with the marketing team
* Infrastructure decisions, executed through the DevOps Engineer
* Tool evaluation and recommendations across the stack
* Sprint tracking and delivery coordination with the agency



  





**What You Will Not Own:** 




  





 Product roadmap. ERP workflow design. BI strategy. Agency commercials. These sit with the founders and other leaders. You are the technical authority on delivery, not the strategist deciding what gets built.
 



  





**What You Must Bring:** 




  




* 5 to 8 years in technology roles, minimum 3 years managing outsourced development teams or agencies
* Vendor review experience with proof: you have found real problems in agency code or architecture and can walk us through specific examples
* ERP implementation or configuration on any major platform (ERPNext, Odoo, Zoho One, SAP Business One, NetSuite, Dynamics 365, or similar). ERP thinking matters more than the platform name.
* Database evaluation: schema design, query performance, MariaDB or Postgres familiarity
* Cloud infrastructure literacy, AWS preferred. Able to evaluate decisions even if not hands\-on daily.
* Integration patterns: APIs, webhooks, ETL, event\-based flows
* Experience where end users are non\-tech staff in physical locations: clinics, hospitals, retail, warehouses
* Configure first. Build only when configuration genuinely cannot solve it.



  





**This Role Is Not for You If:** 




  




* You manage timelines and status reports but have never personally reviewed vendor code or architecture
* You cannot recall a specific instance where you caught a vendor's technical mistake
* Your 90\-day plan centers on building a new product or app
* You have only managed in\-house engineering teams, never an agency or vendor
* You are a coder first. This role reviews and directs. It does not build.
* You have depth in one layer and no working knowledge of the rest



  





**Why Join:** 




  




* One person's technical judgment governs the entire stack. That person is you.
* Founders sit in daily operations. Decisions move in days, not quarters.
* The systems you keep honest serve real patients across 50\+ clinics.
* The network is expanding fast. The technology spine is being built now, under your watch.\|

**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
   

  

 As a Data Center CM you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
   

  

 Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
   

  

 At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team\-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**The Data Center CM Will Be Responsible For**
* Assist in project management and oversight of construction\-related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Hydrabad area, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support efforts to drive costs down and shorten schedules while maintaining quality.
* Contribute to Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
* Participate in reviews of construct\-ability of electrical and mechanical systems and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
* Assist in creating project scope and equipment requirements, help with request for proposals, and capital requests.
* Support total project quality by assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing, and helping oversee the execution of the project.
* Help manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers.
* Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
* Learn to manage multiple projects concurrently, including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
* Provide operational support of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
* Develop leadership skills within the group and in internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Travel to datacenter sites for electrical, mechanical system audits and reviews, construct\-ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required, under supervision.


 A day in the life
   

  

 At Amazon we are a global team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in vendor management
* Experience in a data center or other critical environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of construction or project management experience

* Project Planning \& Execution: Develop and implement comprehensive project execution plans covering scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management for corporate interior fitout projects ranging from 10,000 to 100,000\+ square feet.

* Financial Oversight: Develop, monitor and manage detailed project budgets, including cost estimation, tracking expenditures, approving payment applications, managing change orders, and forecasting costs to completion while identifying opportunities for value engineering.
* Schedule Management: Create, maintain and monitor detailed project schedules using industry\-standard tools, identifying critical path activities, mitigating potential delays, and implementing recovery strategies when necessary.
* Procurement \& Vendor Management: Manage the selection and performance of general contractors, specialty consultants, and vendors; negotiate contracts, review bids, and oversee the procurement process for furniture, fixtures, and equipment.
* Technical Oversight: Review and coordinate design documentation, provide constructability feedback, ensure code compliance, and oversee quality control processes throughout the construction phase.
* Risk Management: Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution to minimize impacts on schedule, budget, and client satisfaction.
* Project Closeout \& Transition: Oversee project closeout activities including punch list completion, systems commissioning, documentation handover, warranty management, and transition to facilities management teams.

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 7\-8 years of progressive experience in project management, with at least 5 years specifically managing commercial interior construction or corporate fitout projects
* Demonstrated experience managing projects with budgets exceeding $1 million
* Strong technical understanding of interior construction methodologies, building systems, and local building codes
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting architectural and engineering drawings
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
* LEED Accredited Professional credential desirable
* Knowledge of workplace design trends and corporate real estate strategies

* Familiarity with construction documentation systems and processes
* Understanding of sustainable design principles and WELL building standards

* Team leadership and ability to influence across organizational boundaries
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving orientation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Client\-centric mindset with strong service orientation
* Meticulous attention to detail while maintaining big\-picture perspective

* Team Development: Mentoring junior staff and contributing to department knowledge sharing


 This role requires a versatile professional who can balance technical expertise with strong client relationship skills while embodying JLL's values of teamwork, ethics, excellence, and client focus in delivering exceptional project outcomes.
